note: Pre-stamp def_retarget builds admitted by freeze/ship without the homm3DefRetargetSourceMesh stamp (source_mesh_identity.py). Each entry was attested once on 2026-09-28 against the file it must be built from (identity review, else the unit's own current smartrigged file): body UV set overlap >= 0.95 and, for a multi-image source, its non-body textures carried byte-identical, and the same number of images as the source (so a single-image unit is not a multi-image retexture twin). Entries only ever leave (test_source_mesh_identity.py checks the list against its first commit): a full run_unit.sh build stamps the unit and its entry is removed. Units refused at attestation are not listed and need that rebuild.
